create.name: Lou Redmond
create.bio:
Lou Redmond is a meditation guide and purpose coach based in Eugene, Oregon. In his mid-twenties a sudden spiritual opening led him to leave a corporate career, and he describes the years that followed as a long search through doubt and several dark nights of the soul before his work took shape. He went on to found One Mindful Education, which brought meditation, yoga and mindfulness into schools, and later trained as a coach with the Coach Training Institute, Aletheia and EVRYMAN. He calls himself a friend on the journey rather than a guru.

His guided meditations, many of them morning practices built around surrender, trust, gratitude and prayer, have been played millions of times on Insight Timer, where he also teaches courses on mantras, paradox and the Prayer of St Francis. In one-to-one sessions he helps people bring a creative calling, offering or project into the world, treating the inner work and the practical work as one. He also speaks to schools and companies about staying grounded through change, wrote the memoir Find Your Truth, and teaches other meditation teachers how to write original scripts and build courses, through a free script-writing course, a paid academy, a podcast and a YouTube channel.

courses.title: 1-1 Purpose Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one coaching for people who want to turn a creative calling, offering or project into real work. Sessions combine inner work on doubt and perfectionism with practical steps, and begin with a free 30-minute discovery call.

courses.title: Meditation Course Creator Academy
courses.description: A self-paced programme for teachers who want to design and record their own meditation course. It covers choosing a theme, structuring lessons, recording and editing, pricing and launching, with guest interviews from other course creators.

courses.title: Living The Prayer Of St. Francis
courses.description: An Insight Timer course that takes the Prayer of St Francis line by line, pairing each phrase with a reflection and a guided practice for bringing it into daily life.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Paradoxes To Live By: Counterintuitive Wisdom For Everyday Life
courses.description: An Insight Timer course of short talks and meditations on spiritual paradoxes, such as letting go in order to receive, and how holding them can bring more ease to ordinary life.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Lou Redmond on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: A large collection of guided meditations, mostly morning practices on gratitude, trust, self-love and surrender, plus short talks. Free to listen to in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Meditation Script Mastery
free_resources.description: A free online course for meditation teachers on writing their own scripts from personal experience rather than templates or AI. It covers finding ideas, imagery and structure.
